title: Stripe's stablecoin stack - Bridge + Privy + Tempo + Open Issuance (the payments giant becomes a stablecoin platform)
source: Public record: Stripe/Bridge/Privy announcements; Tempo (Stripe+Paradigm) launch + Series A; a16z/press analyses; OCC Bridge trust-charter action (Feb 2026). Overlay on the stablecoin-Treasury-rail + payments threads. HONESTY: acquisitions, product launches, charter, and named partners = fact; several third-party figures CONFLICT (Privy wallet counts 50-110M; Bridge deal dated Feb/Apr/May 2025) so specific numbers are graded 'reported, varies'; the 'AWS for money' vertical-integration framing = interpretation.

edges.notes: Patrick Collison (with brother John) co-founded + runs Stripe - the dominant private payments platform now assembling a full stablecoin stack; quiet founder-controlled fintech power (fact).

Stripe acquired Bridge (stablecoin infra; founder Zach Abrams) for ~$1.1B - reported as the largest stablecoin-infrastructure acquisition to date; Bridge's API lets a business accept USDC on Solana, convert to EURC on Ethereum, and settle fiat via one call (fact of deal; exact close date varies across sources - reported Feb/Apr/May 2025).

Stripe acquired Privy (2025) - embedded crypto-wallet infra powering 75M+ (figures vary 50-110M) wallets across 1,000+ teams (e.g. OpenSea) with no seed-phrase UX; the wallet layer of the stack (fact; wallet count reported/varies).

Stripe + Paradigm incubated Tempo (4 Sep 2025) - an independent payments-focused Layer-1 (Matt Huang leads); Series A ~$500M at ~$5B (Thrive/Greenoaks, Oct 2025); mainnet Mar 2026 - completing Stripe's issuance->processing->settlement control + reducing dependence on Ethereum (fact; 'full-stack control' framing = interpretation).
Crypto VC Paradigm co-incubated Tempo with Stripe (first investors); Paradigm's Matt Huang leads it as an independent company - VC + payments-giant capital building settlement rails (fact).

Feb 2026: Bridge received a conditional national TRUST bank charter from the OCC (stablecoin issuance, custody, reserve management) - a second OCC crypto-bank charter alongside Erebor, folding stablecoin issuance under federal oversight (fact; parallels the Erebor + de-novo-charter thread).
Bridge is cross-chain stablecoin payment + orchestration rails (USDC/EURC across Solana/Ethereum, fiat on/off-ramps) - the back end that makes stablecoins usable as ordinary payments (fact).

Tempo is a stablecoin-payments L1 (targets 100k+ TPS, sub-second finality); at/after launch it hosted Klarna's KlarnaUSD (a bank-issued stablecoin) and World Liberty Financial's USD1 (deployed May 2026), with Visa/Nubank/Shopify partners (fact of deployments).

World Liberty Financial (the Trump-family-linked venture) deployed its USD1 stablecoin natively on Tempo (May 2026) - a notable political-crypto tie running on Stripe/Paradigm rails (fact of deployment; political-conflict framing tracked in the CLARITY/ethics thread, graded).

Stripe's Open Issuance (Sep 2025) lets any business launch a custom stablecoin in a few lines of code, with reserves managed by BlackRock, Fidelity, and Superstate; early users Phantom, Hyperliquid, ConsenSys/MetaMask - stablecoin issuance as a Stripe product (fact).

Open Issuance reserves are managed by BlackRock + Fidelity + Superstate - routing stablecoin float into the big asset managers' Treasury/MMF vehicles, wiring Stripe issuance into the stablecoin-Treasury rail (fact; systemic-scale reading graded).
